templates.name: Search car rental with dates and filters
templates.description: Search for rental cars at {location} for {pickup_date}/{dropoff_date} (times optional) and apply filters such as {car_type}, supplier, sorting, then optionally view the deal.
steps: Enter the pick-up location (city, airport or place) and select the suggestion
Pick the pick-up and drop-off dates in the calendar
Set pick-up and drop-off times if specified
Apply filters (car type, supplier, specs, policy)
Sort results (e.g. lowest price first or distance)
Click View deal / go to book if required
